services.name: PADI - Discover Scuba
services.desc: Bella Cruising Experience offers custom dive packages on our Crewed Charters for a truly personalized SCUBA experience. Whether you are new to SCUBA, or a seasoned vet, you are sure to have a great underwater adventure with us! With water temps ranging from 74 degrees in the cooler months to over 85 during the summer, and visibility almost always over 50 feet, the Bahamas are possibly the best place you'll find to learn. Come experience to crystal clear waters and gorgeous reefs like you never have before! services.name: Crewed Charters
services.desc: Our professional captains will elevate your charter experience! Their sailing and cruising knowledge will help create your dream itinerary while keeping your days stress free. Our captains handle all vessel-related responsibilities for a relaxing charter experience. Captained charters are also perfect for people that want to learn the basics of sailing and cruising but don’t want to take a formal course yet, or for sailors that have taken courses that want to practice! Your captain’s responsibilities are limited to the safe operation and maintenance of the vessel, the charterer is responsible for everything else while onboard.
